name: Lucid Theme
description: Lucid: a light, readable theme for EspoCRM. Record view with an owner and pipeline band, collapsible blocks, adjustable columns and an activity stream, in two layouts: Lucid Classic and Lucid Split (fields beside activity). Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA / RGAA). https://github.com/AlexisSantin/espocrm-lucid-theme
author: Alexis SANTIN
